blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The fuel price rollback of up to double digits per liter should be fully implemented by the Department of Energy and oil companies. The rollback was something that a Solon described Wednesday as “rare and significant.” The Department of Energy and oil companies should fully implement a fuel price rollback of up to double digits per liter, something that a solon described Wednesday as “rare and significant”.
